._evt_content ._banner {width:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items: center; margin:60px auto 0; gap:24px;}

._ev_layer ._close {position:absolute; right:33px; top:33px; width:35px; height:35px; background:url("data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf8,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='34.414' height='34.414' viewBox='0 0 34.414 34.414'%3E%3Cg transform='translate(-680.793 -40.793)'%3E%3Cline x2='33' y2='33' transform='translate(681.5 41.5)' fill='none' stroke='%23d1d1d1' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3Cline x1='33' y2='33' transform='translate(681.5 41.5)' fill='none' stroke='%23d1d1d1' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E%0A") 0 0 no-repeat; background-size:34.414px 34.414px;}
